title: Shoggoth wall art — round 11: the held mask
notes: Your O3 idea built: the creature holds its mask out on a tentacle, eye patch behind (see the side views). Vote H + variants. Sketches welcome, never waited on. ··· H combines everything you loved in round 10 (A0, three distinct tentacles, long whip, denser, fangs) plus veiny eyes on the arms instead of suckers. Each V card changes ONE thing vs H. STRUCTURAL REVIEW (as you asked): PASS for H and V3 — a 10 mm steel rod inside the tentacle, mask as a separate bonded part; 40 N bump uses 38% (H) / 46% (V3) of the rod's capacity; 10-year sag under 0.5 mm vs a 3 mm limit. Condition: the arm needs its own wall-screw row into a stud — depends on your stud locations (still unknown). The mask renders a bit darker than round 10 (lighting fix). Canva concept art still needs credits on the account. Not yet peer-signed: the CAD and Structural write-ups for this round.

cards.title: H — mask held out on a tentacle, eye patch behind it
cards.rationale: Your O3 idea built: the smiley floats ~85 mm out from the body, gripped at the rim by a tentacle; behind it a seething patch of 12 bulging, bloodshot eyes in diseased flesh (side view, right). Plus everything you loved in round 10: A0 base, three distinct tentacles, the long whip, denser, long fangs; veiny eyes on the shelf tentacles instead of suckers.
